intro: Jobs similar to models are creative and performance roles in fashion, display and entertainment. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are theatrical makeup artists (69% similar), Merchandise Displayers and Window Trimmers (68%) and Choreographers (65%).
shared: These careers share work on set or on stage, close teamwork with stylists and directors, and attention to how things look. O*NET rates social perceptiveness at 2.88 out of 5 for models and coordination at 2.62. Makeup, choreography, costume and music direction draw on that same production world. Most of the 20 need more training than modeling, and 10 pay more than the $48,470 model median.

faq.q: Which jobs like model pay more?
faq.a: 10 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Art Directors earn $114,850 (137% more), theatrical makeup artists $97,150 (100% more) and Writers and Authors $76,910 (59% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Art direction and writing usually need a bachelor's degree.

faq.q: What is the easiest job similar to modeling?
faq.a: Costume Attendants are the only one of the 20 similar careers that pays more without more preparation. They are 61% similar and earn $50,400, which is 4% more than models. Floral Designers need the same preparation but earn $37,360, about 23% less.
